outcome: mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, cesarean section)
cohort: Women undergoing induction of labor at Al Shifa hospital in Gaza Strip.
finding: Oral misoprostol was effective for delivery and safe outcomes in women under 30 with parity less than 3, but it was associated with higher rates of birth canal injury, failed induction, and uterine rupture compared to PGE2, which had a higher cesarean delivery rate.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery was similar overall, with vaginal delivery rates of 73.6% for oral misoprostol and 75% for PGE2, though PGE2 induction led to a higher cesarean delivery rate (25% vs 18.4%).
